text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Machan, that's dangerous! Forget the 
sparrow, you're gonna fall—!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's alright, Chunmaru-san. I will get you 
down from the tree in a moment. I'll heal 
that hurt wing right up... Whoa, whoops—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Watch out—!
(*SPLASH!*)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Phew, I got a little soaked. But I'm 
fine. Now, hop onto my hand...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Rescue successful. Machan has safely 
returned. See? Everything was fine.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You—you absolute dummy!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Look at how soaked you are, just as we 
feared! Honestly, it's a miracle it was 
only one leg!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What if something worse happened... What 
were you going to do if you got injured?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I get that you wanted to save it, but talk 
to us first! Don't go charging ahead on 
your own, you idiot!!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: You two...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry, you are entirely right. 
Machan has reflected on her actions.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No... I'm just glad you understand. Don't 
do anything reckless from now on, and rely 
on us, got it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, we need to do something about you 
being wet. A handkerchief won't be enough, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A convenience store oughta sell towels. 
Machan, just wait here!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ............... ...It is love, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: —! This aroma...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Machan! Sorry for the wait—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wait, what's with all those taiyaki?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Since we're all here, let's eat them 
together. It is our Worry-iversary.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, is this your way of thanking us? 
All right. Let's dig in after we dry you 
off.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: *inhale*... Yes, what a lovely fragrance.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It tastes fluffy, sweet, and warm... What 
a very, very wonderful taiyaki, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well, it sure is tasty, but... Is it 
really something to get that moved 
over...?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very much so. This is the aroma of 
this fine day...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The two of you were deeply worried about 
me. —A scene of pure love.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wait, l-love...?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Farewells come to everyone equally. 
However—love is immortal. An irreplaceable 
thing.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yet... love has no physical form. It 
cannot be left behind.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That is why... I engrave it deep, deep 
into memory. Together with the aroma and 
taste of taiyaki—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The dashi broth tasted on that day, at 
that moment... brings back memories.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And the scent of black tea revives 
memories of family.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In the same way, the scent of this 
taiyaki... places the love known as worry 
into my heart.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
—Because I want to remember it. The love 
from both of you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's true... Somehow, this taiyaki 
tastes so much better now.

One day while out and about. Lured by a 
fragrant aroma, I stopped by a taiyaki 
stall—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Inhaaale~~... Exhaaale... The scent of 
love, isn't it...?
choice_data_list: The taiyaki here is delicious, isn't it?
The taiyaki here is tasty, huh?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Inhaaale~~... Exhaaale... The scent of 
love, isn't it...?
choice_data_list: The taiyaki here is delicious, isn't it?
The taiyaki here is tasty, huh?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: No. Right now, I am reminiscing.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I smell this scent... Machan 
remembers their pouting, grumbling faces.

Saying so, Aston Machan gazed fondly at 
the taiyaki stall.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes. And it is quite warm.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
After all, this is the taiyaki of love. 
Since I am here, I shall buy three today 
as well.

Aston Machan headed back, clutching the 
taiyaki she bought dearly.
